# DELETE /api/v1/user/starred/{owner}/{repo}

Unstar the given repo for the authenticated user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-156`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — User lacks access to repo
- **404** — Repo does not exist

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.Unstar | controller | Call repo_model.StarRepo with star=false |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | repo_model.StarRepo | repository | Begin transaction; Check if user is starring repo; If not starring, return nil; Delete Star record; Decrement repository.num_stars; Decrement user.num_stars; Commit transaction |
